baselineObservations: Identity and proportions are clear: royal blue pitched canopy, ochre wall fields and wood trim, balanced golden lanterns, three red curtain panels and cream fish.
Original surfaces read as flat blocks. Roof faces, jamb edges, fabric and lantern bodies have little soft local light or material volume at intended size.
Dark navy doorway below the cloth is an intentional recess, not a dead spot to brighten into a wall or fill with details. The muted brown-gray threshold is also intentional architecture.
The plain wall areas and continuous baseboard are intentional modular fields. More ornament, windows, signage, or busy grain would violate their role.
Source assembly demonstrates continuous roof, wall field and baseboard at module boundaries; this continuity must survive refinement.
targetObservations: Useful treatment: broad soft edge highlights, gentle cloth folds, readable rounded lantern volume, warmer wood shading and subtle threshold edge separation.
Target retains the main palette families and recognizable architecture, but its intense cyan roof glints, glossy/plastic edge treatment, broad wall gradients and painterly mottling are not mandatory.

Target has noisy stray alpha pixels and colored perimeter halo, a different canvas (1422x1106), framing/padding drift and rounded silhouette changes. These are target defects or registration drift and cannot authorize source-contract changes.
rankedDesiredOutcomes: Add gentle native light/material volume to roof slabs, wood, lanterns and cloth so the result visibly approaches warm soft cartoon art at 576x448.
Retain clear original color hierarchy and semantic counts; keep the doorway dark and calm, wall fields blank, fish cream and legible, and the gold lanterns luminous without clipping.
Keep protected join planes and shared facade settings continuous in native and independently assembled S previews, with clean alpha and no module shading gradient.
scoreContext: Baseline style evidence only; not a candidate approval threshold. Shape is faithful but softly modeled volume is weak. Readability is good, yet color-block shading is visibly abrupt.
